examples.summary: This standard defines working zone introduction requirements for seal ring housings in Bonfiglioli gearbox assemblies. Key requirements include a minimum 1 mm working zone dimension, diameter-dependent chamfer radii (0.4-1.2 mm), and prohibition of sharp edges on seal seats. Special assembly sequencing is required when bearings and seals share the same fitting diameter, with seals always installed before bearings.

examples.summary: This standard defines the geometric requirements for seal ring housing working zones in gearbox housings. It specifies chamfer angles (2°), relief radii (0.4–1.2 mm based on diameter), minimum effective spacing (1 mm), and assembly sequence rules when bearings and seals share the same fitting diameter. The page includes detailed guidance on surface finish methods (plunge grinding, helical milling) and mandates rounded edges with specified tolerances and roughness in critical zone 'L'.

examples.summary: This standard defines working zone requirements for seal ring housings in Bonfiglioli gearbox assemblies. Key specifications include minimum effective dimensions (a = 1-2 mm), diameter-dependent chamfer radii (R = 0.4-1.2 mm), and surface finish requirements (Ra ≤ 0.8). When bearings and seal rings share the same fitting diameter, the seal ring must be assembled first, followed by the bearing, with all zones clearly annotated with specific tolerances and roughness values.
